import primitive_api as api

ctx = api.get_task_context()
obs = api.inspect_current_view(label="start_view", remember=True)
scan = api.scan_scene(
    queries=["SprayBottle", "Cabinet", "GarbageCan", "Toilet", "SinkBasin"],
    rotations=4,
    include_tilts=True,
    remember=True,
)
mem = api.recall_visible_objects(limit=100)
prog = api.check_progress_public()

print("Goal:", ctx.get("goal"))
print("Initial pose:", obs["observation"]["agent"])
print("Scan query hits:", scan.get("query_hits"))
print("Remembered objects:")
for m in mem:
    print(
        f" - {m.get('objectType')} | id={m.get('objectId')} | dist={m.get('distance')} | pos={m.get('position')}"
    )
print("Progress:", prog)

import primitive_api as api

# Currently at (-0.5, 2.5), rot=180, horizon=30.
# Toilet is at (-0.517, 3.22). Shower is at z=1.73. TowelHolder is at x=-1.72.
# So the rest of the bathroom is toward -x (rotation 270)!
# Let's look up to horizon 0, rotate right to 270, and inspect/move.
api.look("up")
api.rotate("right")
obs1 = api.inspect_current_view(label="face_west", remember=True)
print("Face west pose:", obs1["observation"]["agent"])
print(
    "Visible west:",
    [
        (o["objectType"], o["objectId"], o["distance"], o["position"])
        for o in obs1["visible_objects"]
    ],
)

# Let's move ahead 3 steps toward the west (-x) and inspect
for i in range(3):
    res = api.move_ahead()
    print(f"Move {i+1}:", res.get("ok"), res.get("error"))

obs2 = api.inspect_current_view(label="west_3steps", remember=True)
print("After 3 steps pose:", obs2["observation"]["agent"])
print(
    "Visible now:",
    [
        (o["objectType"], o["objectId"], o["distance"], o["position"])
        for o in obs2["visible_objects"]
    ],
)

# Also rotate right (facing north, 0 deg) and left (facing south, 180 deg) or scan without tilts to see cabinets/sinks/trash bin
